Developer Guide for metabr

Source: DEVELOPER.md

Welcome to the developer guide for metabr (v0.2.3), an R package in the foundr / systems genetics ecosystem designed for metabolite data ingestion, quality control (QC) batch correction, normalization, and curation discrepancy analysis.

This document details package architecture, data models, developer environment setup, core QC algorithms, S3 class definitions, testing procedures, and release guidelines.

1. Ecosystem & Package Architecture

metabr serves as the metabolite data ingestion and standardization layer. It takes raw peak-area spreadsheets output by El-MAVEN or LC-MS mass spectrometry platforms, applies quality control sample batch corrections across runs/plates/batches, and exports normalized datasets for downstream analysis (foundrHarmony →\rightarrowfoundr →\rightarrowfoundrShiny).

Key R Functions & Modules

Module / File Core Functions Description
R/qc_steps.R qc_steps(), calc_cf(), replace_missing_ave_cf(), correct_raw_cf() Main quality control batch-correction engine using QC pool sample ratios
R/read_raw_metab.R read_raw_metab() Imports raw LC-MS peak-area tables, pivots traits, extracts mouse_id, run, rundate, Batch, Plate, time, and rep
R/read_batch_metab.R read_batch_metab() Parses previously batch-corrected multi-sheet Excel files
R/read_metab.R read_metab_minute() Parses minute-specific time-course metabolomics experiments
R/write_metab.R write_metab() Exports processed long-format metabolite data frame into standard wide CSV files
R/norm_merge.R normalize() Applies compound-wise mean-centering and log⁡2\log_2 transformation
R/hand_auto.R hand_auto(), ggplot_hand_auto(), autoplot.hand_auto() S3 class and ggplot methods to compare manual vs. automated curation ratios

2. Developer Environment & Setup

Prerequisites

  • R Version: ≥3.5.0\ge 3.5.0
  • R Packages: dplyr, ggplot2, knitr, readr, purrr, stringr, tibble, tidyr, readxl, utils
  • Optional Suggests: EnrichmentBrowser, OmnipathR, pkgdown

Development Workflow

# 1. Load active package development session
devtools::load_all()

# 2. Update roxygen2 documentation & NAMESPACE
devtools::document()

# 3. Build local pkgdown site to inspect articles and flowcharts
pkgdown::build_site(install = FALSE)

# 4. Run CRAN / package check
devtools::check(cran = FALSE, vignettes = FALSE)

3. Core Quality Control Methodology

The core operation of metabr is plate-level quality control (QC) batch correction driven by qc_steps().

Mathematical Correction Formula

For a given compound cc (and retention time medRt\text{medRt} for untargeted assays) measured in batch bb and plate pp:

  1. Calculate Plate QC Mean: y‾b,p,c,QC=1NQC∑i∈QCb,pyi,c\bar{y}_{b, p, c, \text{QC}} = \frac{1}{N_{\text{QC}}} \sum_{i \in \text{QC}_{b,p}} y_{i, c}

  2. Calculate Global Compound QC Mean: y‾c,QC=1Ntotal QC∑all QCyi,c\bar{y}_{c, \text{QC}} = \frac{1}{N_{\text{total QC}}} \sum_{all \text{ QC}} y_{i, c}

  3. Correction Factor (CF): CFb,p,c=y‾b,p,c,QCy‾c,QC\text{CF}_{b, p, c} = \frac{\bar{y}_{b, p, c, \text{QC}}}{\bar{y}_{c, \text{QC}}}

  4. Batch-Corrected Sample Intensity: ycorrected,i=yraw,iCFb,p,cy_{\text{corrected}, i} = \frac{y_{\text{raw}, i}}{\text{CF}_{b, p, c}}
